settings: Only prompt and reference path exposed; requested dimensions/palette are prompt constraints, not guaranteed output parameters.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FFTA race calibration sprite sheet; pose-conditioned original character.
Input image 1 is an exact native Final Fantasy Tactics Advance pose template, enlarged 16x without smoothing. Use its anatomy, logical pixel density, camera, bounding box, foot contact, head position, limb positions and six-frame correspondence as strict structural guidance. Design a NEW costume and character; do not merely recolor or decorate the donor costume.
Subject: A Bangaa caravan guard: orange reptilian head with long downturned muzzle and swept-back ear fins, sleeveless cream vest with rust edging, indigo waist wrap and dark leg wraps, bare clawed feet. No helmet, weapon, cape, or bag.
Output exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, 1536x1024 canvas, equal 512x512 cells. Each cell represents a 32x32 game cell enlarged exactly 16x nearest-neighbor. Character roughly 27 logical pixels tall and 14-18 wide, matching reference scale; generous blank cell margins. Genuine transparent background; no labels, grid, border, text, scenery, ground oval or cast shadow.
Keyframe semantics: row 1 is front three-quarter facing down-left; row 2 is rear three-quarter facing up-right, as in reference. Columns correspond EXACTLY to reference columns: A first stride extreme, B centered passing/standing phase with slight native bob, C opposite stride extreme. Loop is A-B-C-B with source durations 16,8,16,8. Two distinct feet remain present in every frame. Match each donor's actual feet and arm placement, including race-specific gait. Body facing is fixed within a row. Do not turn a head between columns. Do not mirror A to fabricate C.
All six cells depict ONE identical original design, same head, ears, face, costume seam placement, accessories and colors across phases and front/back. Same scale for all cells. Keep heads as rigid forms with only reference bob.
Style: match the supplied original FFTA sprite's very sparse chunky pixel clusters, one logical pixel dark contour, tiny native face and hands, restrained 3-tone ramps, maximum 15 opaque colors. Construct true low-resolution 32x32 sprites, then nearest-enlarge; do not make a detailed illustration with a pixel filter. No tiny subpixel shading, antialiasing, texture, dithering, gradients, gloss or modern high-resolution pixel art. Crisp square logical pixels only. Do not include donor characters in output.
